info.name: healthcare-org gateway
info.description:
Public API gateway for myhealthcare.dev. 94 CRUD resources + 6 custom actions + a Workflows folder.

**Setup:** import this collection and `gateway-prod.postman_environment.json`, select the env, set `apiKey` to your GATEWAY_API_KEY.

**FK fields** on Create requests use `{{<key>}}` variables so you can set a single valid id once (e.g. `{{patient_id}}=5`) and reuse it across every request. Defaults are all `1`.

**Discovery:** run **Meta → List services** to see every resource. Each folder groups resources by clinical/technical domain matching `frontend/src/services.ts`.

**Cross-service flows:** the **Workflows** folder demonstrates full clinical scenarios (visit → notes → orders → prescription → charge → claim), showing how one encounter ties every downstream service together.

item.description: End-to-end scenarios chaining requests across services. Run in order after setting `patient_id`, `provider_id`, `facility_id`, and `payer_id` collection variables.

item.name: Complete a patient visit and submit claim
item.description: 1. Book appointment → 2. Create encounter → 3. Add note → 4. Order lab → 5. Prescribe → 6. Order imaging → 7. Capture charge → 8. Submit claim.

request.description: Creates the visit slot. Response has the appointment id.
Represents the actual patient-provider interaction. Save id → {{encounter_id}}.
Documents the visit.
Lab order references the encounter so billing can roll it up.
Save the prescription id → {{prescription_id}}.
Save the imaging_order id → {{imaging_order_id}}.
Records the billable work done at the encounter.
Claim references the full encounter graph: patient, rendering provider, visit, payer, and every clinical activity attached to it.
